note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a KAZ 16, 17; A06b KAZ 16, 17; L05 KAZ 21): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Kazakhstan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been lawfully and permanently resident for 5 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Kazachstan to a citizen. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to parents who are both citizens, or to one parent who is a citizen and the other parent is stateless or of unknown citizenship.; Person is born abroad to one parent who is a citizen and at least one parent had permanent residence in Kazachstan at the time of the child's birth. If the parent(s) have permanent residence outside the country, their joint consent is required. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to parents who are both citizens, or to one parent who is a citizen and the other parent is stateless or of unknown citizenship.; Person is born abroad to one parent who is a citizen and at least one parent had permanent residence in Kazachstan at the time of the child's birth. If the parent(s) have permanent residence outside the country, their joint consent is required.
